Title:SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills

Authors:Sanket Badhe, Priyanka Tiwari, Jonghyun Chung
View a PDF of the paper titled SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills, by Sanket Badhe and 2 other authors
View PDF HTML (experimental)
Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents executing complex, long-running procedural skills. We present SKILL.state, a runtime architecture that replaces append-only conversational history with an explicit, mutable execution state.
Comments: accepted at EMNLP
